summary: AI engineer with four years building production LLM systems and the backend around them. I work across LLM integration, routing and reliability — prompt and output-guardrail design, evaluation, caching, and APIs — with strong Python, Node.js/TypeScript, PostgreSQL and Redis. I own systems end to end, with a focus on reliability, latency and cost in production.

bullets: Owned the full AI feature lifecycle in production: architecture, retrieval and prompt design, output validation, deployment, and monitoring.
Designed output-guardrail and validation layers for a production LLM system, evaluating model output and handling non-deterministic responses reliably.
Built the retrieval and data layer (Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis); caching and optimized queries improved data-access performance by **30%** for high-frequency inference calls.
Built an LLM-powered agent that retrieves domain data to generate recommendations and guidance for users.
Built an AI-driven platform with LangChain and RAG pipelines, integrating third-party data and retrieving context to generate personalized outputs.
Developed an AI Virtual Trainer agent with agentic reasoning and personalization, increasing user engagement by **40%**; owned design, development, and deployment.
Engineered a GPT-Canvas-style streaming LLM renderer using token streaming and incremental rendering, achieving **98%** rendering accuracy.
Built a full-stack AI system (Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL) applying LLM extraction to automate workflows.
Built a platform from zero to **$1M+ revenue**, owning backend infrastructure, data models, and scalable APIs across **3,200+ brands** and **190+ countries**.
Built and hardened backend services and REST APIs; improved performance by **25%** through query optimization and caching.
